# Oreo

Oreo offers dark and light modes on an Oreo-inspired palette: black and dark gray with white text, or white and light gray with black text. It adds custom icons and revised navigation styling, and its appearance is adjusted through the CSS variables it provides.

![Oreo screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carols12352/Oreo-theme/HEAD/images/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Oreo"
    author: "carols12352"
    repo:   "carols12352/Oreo-theme"
    slug:   "oreo"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/oreo"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/carols12352/Oreo-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carols12352/Oreo-theme/HEAD/images/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["light", "dark"]
    about: "Apply Oreo's dark and light modes to give Obsidian an Oreo-inspired palette — black and dark gray with white text or white and light gray with black text. Use custom icons and refined navigation styling, and tweak appearance via provided CSS variables for flexible customization."
}
```
